DBaaS Operator installed successfully!

Release : {{ .Release.Name }}
Namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
Version  : {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}

1. Verify the operator is running:

   kubectl get pods -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
   kubectl logs -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} -l control-plane=controller-manager -f

2. Create a PostgreSQL database (edit values to match your cluster):

   cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
   apiVersion: dbaas.opencloud.wso2.com/v1alpha1
   kind: DBInstance
   metadata:
     name: my-database
     namespace: <tenant-namespace>
   spec:
     dbInstanceClass: db.t3.small
     allocatedStorage: 20
     engineVersion: "16"
     dbName: myapp
     masterUsername: dbadmin
     manageMasterUserPassword: true
     networkRef: <namespace/nad-name>   # existing Multus NAD
     deletionProtection: true
     running: true
   EOF

3. Watch provisioning (takes ~3 minutes on stock Ubuntu images):

   kubectl get dbi -A -w

4. Get connection details once phase=Available:

   kubectl get dbi my-database -n <tenant-namespace> -o yaml

Docs: https://github.com/wso2/open-cloud-datacenter/tree/operators/database
